definitions.explanation: To pick one option from multiple possibilities. Used for selecting items, making decisions, or choosing people for positions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{好|す}きな→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦もの→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{選|えら}んで。
⟦{好|す}きな→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{選|えら}んで⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please choose the color you like.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧{選|えら}んで⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦どれ→どれ：00547_dore⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{選|えら}べば⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦わかりませんでした→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: There were many books, so I didn't know which to choose.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). No pair verb. Pattern: Xを{選|えら}ぶ (choose X).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state or ongoing selection process. {選|えら}んでいる = 'have chosen' or 'is choosing.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・〜を{選|えら}ぶ (choose ~)
・〜から{選|えら}ぶ (choose from ~)
・{好|す}きなものを{選|えら}ぶ (choose what you like)
・{選|えら}ばれる (be chosen - passive)

The passive {選|えら}ばれる is common for elections and selections.
